title: CallCtrAgentFavTrfrDest - Data API
description: Represents a transfer destination that has been marked (starred) as a favorite in the Omni-Channel softphone by a contact center agent for voice call transfers. This object is available in API version 55.0 and later.

AgentId.description: The unique ID of the contact center agent who marked the transfer destination as a favorite. This field is a relationship field.

CallCenterId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CallCenterId.description: The unique ID of the contact center from where the agent starred the transfer destination as a favorite. This field is a relationship field.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the transfer destination record that’s marked as a favorite.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The unique ID of the user who owns this object. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

TransferDestination.description: The unique ID of the transfer destination that’s marked as a favorite. This is an external ID.

Id.field_label: Call Center Agent Favorite Transfer Destination ID
